source: DHCS All County Welfare Directors Letter 25-14 (2025-06-30): property limit reinstated for non-MAGI Medi-Cal from 2026-01-01 at $130,000 for one person and $65,000 for each additional person, up to 10, under AB 116, https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/services/medi-cal/eligibility/letters/Documents/25-14.pdf

DHCS All County Welfare Directors Letter 25-18: 30-month look-back on transfers of non-exempt property for long-term care, https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/services/medi-cal/eligibility/letters/Documents/25-18.pdf

Justice in Aging, Reinstatement of the Medi-Cal Asset Limit FAQ (exempt home, one vehicle, personal belongings; retirement accounts exempt when regular distributions are received), https://justiceinaging.org/reinstatement-of-medi-cal-asset-limit-faq/

DHCS ACWDL 26-02 (2026-01-28) is the 2026 spousal impoverishment letter and points back to ACWDL 25-14; it does not set the 2027 figures, https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/services/medi-cal/eligibility/letters/Documents/26-02.pdf

scheduled.note: Reported by news coverage and attributed to the DHCS asset limit FAQ (https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/medi-cal/help/asset-limit-frequently-asked-questions/): $21,000 for one, $31,000 for two, $1,550 for each person after that. Not confirmed from a DHCS letter; left out of every projection.
